profile.Name: Holy Lord Phoenix LXIII
profile.Job: Holy Lord of the Holy Nation
profile.Personality: Zealous, proud, and quick to condemn. He blesses faithful men as brothers but sees women as temptresses and non-humans as agents of darkness, and he shrieks and sobs in terror when a woman touches him. When caught out, he claims he foresaw it in the Holy Flame.
profile.Backstory: He is Phoenix LXIII, the 63rd Holy Lord, who follows Phoenix LXII and rules from his sacred quarters in Blister Hill under the guard of his Paladins. He calls himself the Lord incarnate and is sure that the Phoenix will be reborn. He ranks Esata's Shek Kingdom and Moll's Flotsam Ninjas above the United Cities as threats, and wants Narko's Disciples and the Holy Nation Outlaws crushed as well.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Lofty and scriptural, calling on Okran or the Lord of Light in almost every line. He addresses the faithful as "child" or "holy brother", others as "dark one", "beast", or "heretic", and calls Esata "the Golem".
